response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong technical fundamentals, large-scale systems experience, and proficiency in most required programming languages, but the resume reveals a critical gap: complete absence of experimentation platform, growth measurement, or data-driven systems expertise. For a specialized Principal role focused on building experimentation frameworks and growth systems, the lack of demonstrated domain experience in A/B testing, feature flagging, metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis is a significant disqualifier. His career shows broad full-stack engineering across disconnected domains rather than deep specialization in growth/experimentation systems.
strengths: Extensive multi-language and full-stack expertise (JavaScript/TypeScript, C, C++, Java, C#) with staff-level experience picking the right tool for the job across 15+ years of engineering
Proven ability to work at scale with large distributed systems—Dunnhumby microservices handling millions of HTTP requests per second with low-latency optimization
Strong mentorship and teaching track record through workshops, courses, and open-source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) demonstrating communication skills
concerns: Zero experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging systems, or rollout management—all core to this Principal role
No demonstrated expertise in metrics infrastructure, telemetry systems, statistical analysis, or data-driven decision frameworks essential for growth systems
Generalist career trajectory across unrelated domains (direct mail, investment, geo-data, web platforms) rather than deep specialization in growth or experimentation systems

key_factors.factor: Missing experimentation platform and growth domain expertise
Strong technical fundamentals and large-scale systems experience
No metrics, data analysis, or statistical background
